title: Career
description: Canonical, app-owned career record. Ingested ONCE from oggdude_merged.json `careers` (20 entries, clean dicts). Specializations are id-refs, NOT embedded — normalizeOggdude embedded full spec objects (talent tree included) inside every career, duplicating each spec; canonical joins at load. Replaces normalizeOggdude's career block.
$comment: INGEST CONTRACT — CareerSkills.Key / Specializations.Key are scalar-or-list (coerce to list); skill keys resolve via skills.vocab (fail-loud); spec keys -> spec ids (referential integrity, Layer 1). FreeRanks present only on the 8 careers granting !=4 (the 6 F&D careers + GUARD/JEDI, all '3') -> free_ranks is EXPLICIT on every record: 4 default (eote p.89: one rank in 4 of the 8 career skills) else to_int(FreeRanks). Attributes captured ONLY for non-zero ForceRating (F&D careers grant FR 1, fad p.282); all-zero Attributes blocks are OggDude editor noise — dropped with an integrity check that every non-ForceRating member is '0'/'false', else fail loud.

career_skills.description: The career's career skills (8 in EotE/AoR, 6 in FaD), as canonical skill ids (R-M12B-96). Career skills advance at 5×new-rank; non-career at 5×new-rank+5 (eote p.101-102; aor p.104).

specializations.description: Specialization id-refs available in-career. Additional specs cost 10× the new total; +10 surcharge when non-career (eote p.102; fad p.106).

free_ranks.description: Free career-skill ranks granted at creation by this career (player's choice among career_skills). 4 for EotE/AoR careers (eote p.89); 3 for the F&D-style Force careers (OggDude FreeRanks). The starting specialization grants 2 more from its own list (eote p.44). NOTE: the legacy creator hardcoded 4 (player FCSkillPicker) — wrong for F&D careers; canonical data fixes this by construction.

starting_entitlements.description: Things the career grants at creation that are not skills or ranks. Added by F-EDS-6 (ruling f-eds-6-careers-strip-recon §4.3) to give the Bounty Hunter's automatic IPKC a structural home — it previously existed only inside the verbatim book prose that lap removed, and so reached no user. An ARRAY because a second entitlement in the line is likelier than never.

career_powers.description: F-100 M12 Career Powers (R-M12C-86): the career's two Force powers (primer p.5, the career's group row; e.g. CONSULAR Influence, Move). At creation one of them is a free basic power (primer p.4); afterwards a basic power on the character's career powers takes the Mentor discount the book prints (FaD Core p.109, R-M12C-87). Pack-overlay only (D-146); DARK (R-M12B-2).

effects.description: F-100 M12 career Attributes as effect rows (R-M12C-79 shape B, R-M12C-100): what the career itself adds to a sheet number, in the existing ops. Absent = none (every shipped career). The OggDude ingest's all-zero Attributes stay dropped ($comment above); a non-zero key maps 1:1 (Docs/briefs/f100-m12-gate-table.md §4). DARK (R-M12B-2).

xp_adjustment.description: F-100 M12 (R-M12C-79/100): OggDude's career Attributes `Experience`, the ONE flat field — a delta on the creation XP pool, the career's twin of a species option's `xp_adjustment`. Absent = 0 (every shipped career). Read by CharResolve.careerXpAdjustment ONLY, DARK (R-M12B-2).
